name: Compile tract macro-structural and profile data
summary: Merges tract macrostructural statistics (for example from Tractography Quality Check) with tract profile measures into a single tractmeasures CSV per subject, using pandas.
description: Reads the macrostructure CSV and the tract profiles CSV, harmonises subject and tract names (removing underscores, hyphens and dots), merges them on subjectID and structureID, and appends the whole-brain (wbfg) row. Use it to prepare one table per subject for group analyses of tract shape and microstructure. Needs a profiles tractmeasures and a macro tractmeasures from the same subject with matching tract names.

inputs.description: Tract profiles CSV (tractmeasures with node-wise microstructure values per tract).
Tract macrostructure CSV (for example from Tractography Quality Check) with one row per tract and a wbfg whole-brain row.

outputs.description: tractmeasures.csv combining profile and macrostructural measures per tract, plus the whole-brain row.

citations.text: Avesani P. et al. The open diffusion data derivatives. Sci Data 6, 69 (2019).

failure_modes.message: stats computations failed somewhere. please check logs and derivatives
failure_modes.fix: Check that tract names in the two inputs match and inspect the log.
